## Summary of Changes

Provide a clear and concise summary of the proposed changes, the motivations behind them, and what problem they resolve.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI / Tooling improvement

## Related Issues

Fixes #(issue number)

## Testing Performed

- [ ] All existing and new tests pass locally (`npm test`)
- [ ] Edge cases and scope constraints verified
- [ ] Mock mode verified for autonomous missions (`node index.js --autonomous --allowMock`)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and formatting conventions of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have updated the documentation where applicable
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or unhandled rejections
